panels.title: Latest Telemetry (DB Time)

panels.description: One row per unresolved MIS incident, ordered by severity and acknowledgement state. This is workflow state, not a guessed alarm-active state.

targets.rawSql:
WITH reference AS (
  SELECT MAX(logdate) AS reference_time FROM public.ldi_alarm_log
)
SELECT
  i.severity AS "Severity",
  i.status AS "Status",
  i.machine_id AS "Machine",
  i.alarm_code AS "Alarm Code",
  i.problem AS "Problem",
  i.first_seen AS "First Seen",
  i.last_seen AS "Last Seen",
  i.event_count AS "Events",
  COALESCE(i.owner_team, 'UNASSIGNED') AS "Owner Team",
  COALESCE(i.assignee, 'UNASSIGNED') AS "Assignee",
  i.sla_due_at AS "SLA Due",
  CASE
    WHEN i.sla_due_at < r.reference_time THEN 'OVERDUE'
    ELSE 'WITHIN SLA'
  END AS "SLA"
FROM public.mis_incident_overview i
CROSS JOIN reference r
WHERE i.status NOT IN ('RESOLVED','CLOSED')
  AND i.last_seen >= $__timeFrom()
  AND i.first_seen <= $__timeTo()
  AND i.factory IN (${factory:sqlstring})
  AND i.process IN (${process:sqlstring})
  AND i.machine_id IN (${machine_id:sqlstring})
ORDER BY
  CASE i.severity WHEN 'CRITICAL' THEN 1 WHEN 'MAJOR' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END,
  CASE i.status WHEN 'NEW' THEN 1 WHEN 'ACKNOWLEDGED' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END,
  i.last_seen DESC
LIMIT 200;

panels.title: $layout_machine_id

panels.description: One canonical row per telemetry machine. ALARM comes from unresolved MIS workflow incidents; freshness is relative to the newest database telemetry timestamp.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  s.machine_id AS "Machine",
  s.factory AS "Factory",
  s.process AS "Process",
  s.health_status AS "Status",
  s.latest_telemetry AS "Latest Telemetry",
  s.data_age_minutes AS "Data Age (min)",
  s.mo AS "MO",
  ROUND(s.temperature::numeric, 1) AS "Temp (°C)",
  ROUND(s.humidity::numeric, 1) AS "RH (%)",
  COALESCE(s.incident_status, 'NO INCIDENT') AS "Incident",
  s.incident_severity AS "Severity",
  s.alarm_code AS "Alarm Code"
FROM public.mis_machine_status s
WHERE s.factory IN (${factory:sqlstring})
  AND s.process IN (${process:sqlstring})
  AND s.machine_id IN (${layout_machine_id:sqlstring})
ORDER BY
  CASE s.health_status WHEN 'ALARM' THEN 1 WHEN 'DOWN' THEN 2 WHEN 'STALE DATA' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END,
  s.machine_id;

panels.title: Machine Status — Latest Telemetry & Incident Context

panels.description: Daily alarm-event trend by source priority.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  $__timeGroupAlias(a.logdate, '1d'),
  CASE m.alarm_type WHEN 'A' THEN 'Alarm (A)' WHEN 'W' THEN 'Warning (W)' ELSE 'Unmapped' END AS metric,
  COUNT(*)::double precision AS value
FROM public.ldi_alarm_log a
LEFT JOIN public.ldi_alarm_ms_code m ON m.alarm_code = a.errorcode
WHERE $__timeFilter(a.logdate)
  AND a.factory IN (${factory:sqlstring})
  AND a.process IN (${process:sqlstring})
  AND a.equipmentid IN (${machine_id:sqlstring})
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: Alarm Trend

panels.description: Machines generating the most alarm events in the selected scope.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT a.equipmentid AS "Machine", COUNT(*)::double precision AS "Events"
FROM public.ldi_alarm_log a
WHERE $__timeFilter(a.logdate)
  AND a.factory IN (${factory:sqlstring})
  AND a.process IN (${process:sqlstring})
  AND a.equipmentid IN (${machine_id:sqlstring})
GROUP BY a.equipmentid
ORDER BY "Events" DESC
LIMIT 10;

panels.title: Most Impacted Machines

panels.description: Recurring alarm codes ranked by event count. Use this to prioritize permanent corrective action and Alarm Master cleanup.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  a.errorcode AS "Alarm Code",
  COALESCE(NULLIF(BTRIM(m.alarm_msg), ''), 'Unmapped alarm code') AS "Problem",
  COALESCE(m.alarm_type, 'UNMAPPED') AS "Type",
  COUNT(*)::double precision AS "Events"
FROM public.ldi_alarm_log a
LEFT JOIN public.ldi_alarm_ms_code m ON m.alarm_code = a.errorcode
WHERE $__timeFilter(a.logdate)
  AND a.factory IN (${factory:sqlstring})
  AND a.process IN (${process:sqlstring})
  AND a.equipmentid IN (${machine_id:sqlstring})
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
ORDER BY "Events" DESC
LIMIT 10;

panels.title: Latest Telemetry (DB Time)

panels.description: Latest-known health for every selected machine. Health uses the newest ldi_data timestamp in the database as its reference so historical imported data is not compared with the wall clock. Incident status uses real alarms inside the dashboard time range.

targets.rawSql:
WITH machine_sources AS (
  SELECT d.eqp_id AS machine_id, d.factory::text AS factory, d.process::text AS process FROM public.ldi_data d WHERE d.factory IN (${factory:sqlstring}) AND d.process IN (${process:sqlstring}) AND d.eqp_id IN (${machine_id:sqlstring})
  UNION ALL
  SELECT a.equipmentid AS machine_id, a.factory::text AS factory, a.process::text AS process FROM public.ldi_alarm_log a WHERE a.factory IN (${factory:sqlstring}) AND a.process IN (${process:sqlstring}) AND a.equipmentid IN (${machine_id:sqlstring}) AND a.equipmentid IS NOT NULL
), selected_machines AS (
  SELECT machine_id, MIN(factory) AS factory, MIN(process) AS process FROM machine_sources GROUP BY machine_id
), reference AS (SELECT MAX("time") AS reference_time FROM public.ldi_data)
SELECT
  sm.machine_id AS "Machine", sm.factory AS "Factory", sm.process AS "Process",
  CASE WHEN t."time" IS NULL THEN 'NO DATA' WHEN t."time" < r.reference_time - INTERVAL '15 minutes' THEN 'STALE DATA' WHEN t.state IS TRUE THEN 'RUN' ELSE 'DOWN' END AS "Health",
  t."time" AS "Latest Telemetry",
  CASE WHEN t."time" IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE ROUND((EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (r.reference_time - t."time")) / 60.0)::numeric, 1) END AS "Data Age (min)",
  CASE WHEN a.logdate IS NULL THEN 'NO INCIDENT' ELSE 'INCIDENT FOUND' END AS "Incident Status",
  a.logdate AS "Latest Alarm", a.errorcode AS "Alarm Code"
FROM selected_machines sm
CROSS JOIN reference r
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT d."time", d.state FROM public.ldi_data d WHERE d.eqp_id = sm.machine_id ORDER BY d."time" DESC LIMIT 1) t ON TRUE
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT al.logdate, al.errorcode FROM public.ldi_alarm_log al WHERE al.equipmentid = sm.machine_id AND $__timeFilter(al.logdate) ORDER BY al.logdate DESC LIMIT 1) a ON TRUE
ORDER BY sm.machine_id;

targets.rawSql: WITH reference AS (SELECT MAX(logdate) AS reference_time FROM public.ldi_alarm_log) SELECT i.incident_id::text AS "Incident ID", i.severity AS "Severity", i.status AS "Status", i.machine_id AS "Machine", i.alarm_code AS "Alarm Code", i.problem AS "Problem", i.first_seen AS "First Seen", i.last_seen AS "Last Seen", i.event_count AS "Events", i.owner_team AS "Owner Team", COALESCE(i.assignee, 'UNASSIGNED') AS "Assignee", i.sla_due_at AS "SLA Due", CASE WHEN i.status IN ('RESOLVED','CLOSED') THEN 'CLOSED' WHEN i.sla_due_at < r.reference_time THEN 'OVERDUE' ELSE 'WITHIN SLA' END AS "SLA" FROM public.mis_incident_overview i CROSS JOIN reference r WHERE i.last_seen >= $__timeFrom() AND i.first_seen <= $__timeTo() AND i.factory IN (${factory:sqlstring}) AND i.process IN (${process:sqlstring}) AND i.machine_id IN (${machine_id:sqlstring}) ORDER BY CASE WHEN i.status IN ('RESOLVED','CLOSED') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, CASE i.severity WHEN 'CRITICAL' THEN 1 WHEN 'MAJOR' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, i.last_seen DESC LIMIT 500;
